title: PII Instrument
description: A PII instrument containing a token from a trusted PII provider. Mirrors PaymentInstrument: the agent never sees raw PII, only this token-based reference.

handler_id.description: PII handler identifier (matches a handler from the merchant UCP profile).

credential.description: Token credential for resolving PII without exposing raw data.

fields_stored.description: PII field names available via this token.

loan_type.description: Loan type this PII profile covers.

platform_id.description: Platform this token was minted for. Null for legacy single-token fallback.
